sections.label: logX
sections.description: Plot the x axis (time, lag, distance) logarithmically.

sections.label: logY(fit)
sections.description: Plot the data and the model logarithmically; the residual strips stay linear.

sections.label: Density
sections.description: Divide the data and the model by the bin width, so curves with different binnings compare.

sections.label: display group
sections.description: Display all fits in the group. The current fit is highlighted, the others are transparent.

sections.label: Reference
sections.description: What the curves are drawn relative to: the raw counts, or a transform the model offers (normalised, divided by a reference decay, ...).
The parameters of the selected reference transform.

buttons.description: Reset the reference transform's parameters to their defaults.
Save the current axis range as the default preset for this reference mode.

sections.description: Fix the lower end of the x axis to the value beside it; off, the axis follows the data.

sections.label: xmin
sections.description: Lower end of the x axis, used while xmin is ticked.
Fix the lower end of the y axis to the value beside it; off, the axis follows the data.

sections.label: ymin
sections.description: Lower end of the y axis, used while ymin is ticked.
Fix the upper end of the x axis to the value beside it; off, the axis follows the data.

sections.label: xmax
sections.description: Upper end of the x axis, used while xmax is ticked.
Fix the upper end of the y axis to the value beside it; off, the axis follows the data.

sections.label: ymax
sections.description: Upper end of the y axis, used while ymax is ticked.

sections.label: x-shift
sections.description: Shift every curve along x by this much (display only; the fit is unchanged).

sections.label: y-shift
sections.description: Shift every curve along y by this much (display only; the fit is unchanged).
The curves of the plot. Untick E to hide a curve; the fit is unchanged.

columns.tooltip: The curve's position in the plot.
